notes.title: Demo Update LIVE
notes.content:
[b]Ahoy, Sailors[/b] – the new Beacon Patrol Demo is here! 🚢⚓

The updated demo has just docked, and it brings a boatload of improvements with it! This isn’t just a small patch — it’s a big step forward that gives you a much clearer and more polished taste of the full [b]Beacon Patrol[/b] experience.

And before we forget: We’ve also got new crew on board! We’re thrilled to share that we’ve teamed up with the capable landsmen at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/AssembleEntertainment]Assemble Entertainment[/url], who are now supporting us on the publishing side of things for [b]Beacon Patrol[/b]! They’ll be helping us spread the word across the seven seas — and beyond. Welcome aboard, Assemble! ⚓

Now, back to you! We want to give a heartfelt thank you to everyone who played the previous demo and First Horizons. Your feedback was incredibly valuable and helped shape many of the changes you’ll find in this update.

Here's what’s new:
[list]
[*]🗺️ [b]New Localizations[/b] – Added additional language support for the demo 
[*]🆕 [b]Updated Tutorial[/b] – No more rule sheets! A step-by-step system now guides you through the game.
[*]🌊 [b]Exploration Mode[/b] – A digitally exclusive mode with progression, unlockables, and cozy missions.
[*]💾 [b]Auto-Save System[/b] – Your patrols are now saved at the start of each turn.
[*]🎧 [b]Audio Overhaul[/b] – Enjoy new music and a host of cozy sound effects.
[*]🎮 [b]Better Gamepad Support[/b] – Redesigned controls for intuitive play on Steam Deck and beyond.
[*]🔍 [b]Custom Zoom Options[/b] – Adjust direction and sensitivity to your liking.
[*]🛠️ [b]Improved UX + Bug Fixes[/b] – Smoother than ever.
[/list]
The new demo acts as a “lite” version of the full game’s Exploration Mode, giving you a limited—but meaningful—slice of what’s to come.

So hop back in, set sail, and explore everything the updated demo has to offer!

[previewyoutube=2xPLchgUKG8;full][Insert trailer here][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/c3b4a8e4ba1da54226f3d3f7e8c5f72fba3449ca.png[/img]

It’s always a good thing to be multilingual when you’re out on the wild waters.

The demo officially supports the following languages:
[list]
[*]✅ English
[*]✅ German
[*]✅ Japanese
[*]✅ Simplified Chinese
[*]✅ Turkish
[*]✅ Russian
[/list][b]Note: This doesn’t mean we won’t add more languages in the future. We’re constantly evaluating new options as we sail toward release. Stay tuned![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/a565240d772317c0ccdc72bafd30b12496fbb30e.png[/img]

No more overwhelming rule sheet at the start!

We now have a step-by-step tutorial system to guide you through the basics. Forgot something? No worries—you can revisit any part of the tutorial via the pause menu.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/dad5ed99d09dcc6bec5e7c781cc9435f86b68698.jpg[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/66fae78300277c819d2ec6d909d817495094d357.jpg[/img][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/86fe9b77c0a072d245d3a9c8fb44fc8ce5af8eef.png[/img]

Our new [b]digitally exclusive Exploration Mode[/b] lets you unlock new ships, abilities, tiles, and cosmetics by completing missions.

Don’t worry: the board game mode is still there and fully accessible. Exploration Mode is just a new way to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/4b07897b63786b6ee0345af6d9aaf15ed6acbed8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/972fe2b8eb356f3147b366c8f548d8a04892ca94.png[/img]

Check out all unlockable content and cosmetics in the new Treasury menu! You can preview unlocked items and see how to unlock the rest. Most of them unlock naturally just by playing—no backflips required.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/8a9f64441f28d1f6ed8e1515dfcb46bac7133d97.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/4a411391ab38cc6c2c3e0cab508b79951aea2bd9.png[/img]

You asked for it, we delivered: The game now does an autosave at the beginning of every turn, and you have three save slots available per game mode.

Just pause and return to the main menu—or close the game—your progress will be safe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/b463ddfe04adb2eeced1529fd494e66491c2700a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/8bc02437457a85bb18be754efdeb3b2814b9dc02.png[/img]

There’s too much to list, but here’s a taste:
[list]
[b][*] Tons of cozy new sound effects
[*] New music for menus
[*] Smooth transitions between menus and gameplay[/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/2dfaa830218c22d6902cd459f877bebf6a97452a.png[/img]

We’ve completely reworked gamepad controls and UI. No more switching between movement and placement modes—it's now seamless and intuitive!

Feel free to test it out!

Supported controllers:
[list]
[b][*] Xbox Series X
[*] Xbox One
[*] DualShock 4 (PS4)
[*] DualSense (PS5)
[*] Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
[*] Steam Deck[/b]
[/list][u][h3]That’s all for now![/h3][/u]
We’re incredibly excited for you to dive into the new demo and see all the changes for yourself. It’s been a joy bringing this cozy new slice of [b]Beacon Patrol[/b] to life!

Until next time—stay safe on the seas and keep patrolling. 🧭✨

notes.title: Demo Version 0.8.10
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're so happy to finally bring you the cute companions you deserve at sea!
Your seagull friend will be at your side while you map these uncharted waters.

In a future update we plan to bring tips and comments to our little fellas, but for now they just cheer you on and celebrate when you complete missions or score points.

You can unlock new seagull buddies by reaching new ranks in-game.

Furthermore we have finally added the possibility to have a look at your finished map once you have finished a game.

[list]
[*] Game Over Screen now allows you to move the camera and look at your finished map
[*] Added animated seagull companions in-game
[*] Seagulls can be unlocked by reaching new ranks (sailor, captain, navigator, cartographer)
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Happy sailing to you and your seagull friends!

notes.content:
Hey everyone,

While version 0.8.5 brings a lot of changes under the hood, as we completed the multiplayer feature for the full game.
Bug fixes for controller support are the only bigger change visible for now in the demo, though.

[list]
[*] Updated Input System
[*] Corrected swapped button glyphs for Switch Pro Controllers 
[*] Added animation to Player Setup screen
[*] Fixed input issues with UI in some edge cases
[*] Undoing the exploration of a tile now correctly hides that tiles score again
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the quality of life changes.

Happy sailing!

notes.title: Demo Version 0.7.11
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Version 0.7.11 brings many improvements to the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/2e50260ce5988de300766c8dd913f74db054335e.png[/img]

New Features:
- New ship colors (orange, green, rose, violet)
- Background selection
- Ship color & flag icon selection
- Highscore visible on title screen
- Score visible on explored Tiles

Bugfixes:
- No more [i]orphaned missions[/i] if a mission is completed during its spawn animation or other similar situations.
- [i]Draw Tile[/i] sounds are now synchronized with the animation
- Drag and Drop for tiles also works when clicking on the indicator above the tile
- Tile selection sound does not play twice when simply clicking on tiles to select them
- Fixed various situations where tile preview was behaving funny (unresponsive, etc)

This version also lays the groundworks for in-game controller support (not activated yet) and localization support!

Version 0.6.20 brings some first scoring UI improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876675/cfcb0cede51d47369832d68b911ed3d9ce59938f.png[/img]

- Tiles display their score when you explore them
- Hover over a tile to see its score (if any)
- Hover over the total score on the top left to see all tile scores

This is not exciting yet, but full controller support is in the works!
